msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia el-vestidor-baza-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a white knit mini dress with white feather cuffs and a feather hem from the reference, walking at a sunny square in the old town of Baza, Granada, Spain, with stone buildings and trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light.
